column1: # Benchmark 10's community, written out in full: four genomes, two genera, one
# known species and one novel species in each. Unlike benchmarks 5/6/7 the
# coverage and the truth taxonomy are stated here rather than looked up in the
# GTDB metadata, because two of the four genomes are absent from r207 and so have
# no metadata row to look up. `taxonomy` is the ground-truth lineage: full species
# for the known members, genus-only for the two whose species is new in r214.
# role: known_50x  = species present in every r207 database, at 50x
#       novel_10x  = species new in r214 (genus known), at 10x
#       novel_100x = species new in r214 (genus known), at 100x
# The two known members must be unambiguously assignable, or the benchmark measures
# GTDB's species boundaries instead of the tools. Both were checked against
# ../shadow_vs_gtdb.skani.csv for ANI to their *own* species' r207 representative
# minus ANI to the nearest *other* species' representative:
#   GCF_000964315.1  s__Streptococcus equinus  own 97.10  next 89.22  margin +7.88
#   GCF_902375985.1  s__Collinsella ihuae      own 100.00 next 84.11  margin +15.89
# Both are non-representative strains, so the species is in the databases via a
# different genome -- the known-species condition the shadow pool exists to give.
# An earlier draft used GCA_900762955.1 (s__Collinsella sp900758375), which sits
# *closer to another species' representative than to its own* (94.98 vs 95.19,
# margin -0.21): all four tools called it a different Collinsella species, so that
# leg of the design tested nothing. Keep the margin comfortably positive.
